prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1127; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's fine.

Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision in Pearland, Texas?

A: Yes, I was driving my sedan. I was stopped at a red light on the access road when it happened.

Q: Can you describe what happened right before the impact?

A: I was waiting for the light to change. I had my foot on the brake and I was looking ahead. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind, like my car got shoved forward into the intersection.

Q: Were you able to see the other vehicle before the collision?

A: No, I didn't see it coming. I only saw it in my mirror after the impact.

Q: Did you exit your vehicle or stay inside after the accident?

A: I stayed in the car for a minute because my neck and upper back hurt right away. Then I got out and talked to the other driver.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatories. I've also been doing some physical therapy exercises at home.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, I still have stiffness when I turn my head, and sometimes a dull ache across my shoulders by the end of the day. It's better than it was, but it's not gone.

Q: Have you missed any work or daily activities because of your injuries?

A: I missed a couple of days at work, and I've had trouble sleeping comfortably. Lifting anything heavy bothers me.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
